trial_court: Civil (Senior Division) Judge court at Bhimavaram, West Godavari District
case_name: Varadaha Pothuri Manjusha vs Varadha Budha Malleswara Rao

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Varadaha @ Pothuri Manjusha, W/o Varadha Budha Malleswara Rao (wife)
parties.respondent_defendant: Varadha Budha Malleswara Rao, S/o Veera Kota Venkata Subba Rao (husband)

acts_cited_auto: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

acts_cited.act: Protection of Women from DV Act, 2005

facts_of_case: Petitioner is the legally wedded wife of respondent. They filed a petition under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure seeking transfer of H.M.O.P.No.66 of 2023 to IV Additional District Judge-cum-Family Court, Vijayawada, Krishna District.

legal_principles.principle: A woman, depending upon the mercy of her parents along with her female child aged about 4 years, it is very difficult for her to travel at a distance of more than 130 Kms from Vijayawada, Krishna District to Bhimavaram, West Godavari District, without any male assistance.
legal_principles.held: The material on record prima facie goes to show that in view of the matrimonial disputes between both the spouses, the petitioner/wife has been residing separately along with her female child aged about 4 years at her parents' house at Vijayawada, Krishna District.

legal_principles.principle: A person seeking transfer of a case should demonstrate sufficient cause for the same.
legal_principles.held: The learned counsel for the petitioner further contended that the petitioner being a woman, depending upon the mercy of her parents along with her female child aged about 4 years, it is very difficult for her to travel at a distance of more than 130 Kms from Vijayawada, Krishna District to Bhimavaram, West Godavari District, without any male assistance.

outcome.final_order: The petition was allowed and the case was transferred from the file of Civil (Senior Division) Judge court at Bhimavaram to IV Additional District Judge-cum-Family Court, Vijayawada.
